literal: Duty without spoiling to show consideration to those who are able, right possesses this world.
translation: This world rightfully belongs to those who are able to show consideration without compromising their duty.
modern: தம்முடைய கடமை கெடாமல் மற்றவர்களிடம் இரக்கம் காட்ட முடிகிறவர்களுக்கு, இந்த உலகம் உரிமை உடையதாகும்.
explanation: This couplet explores the delicate balance between executing one's responsibilities and maintaining human empathy. The phrase 'கருமம் சிதையாமல்' stresses that a person's primary duty or task must never be compromised. At the same time, 'கண்ணோட வல்லார்க்கு' highlights the rare ability to still show consideration and grace to others. The text concludes that the world rightfully belongs to those who can successfully harmonize strict duty with compassionate understanding.
